answer: Each whisper, one claimed agent, is placed in a facet of the crystal, a registry that clusters agents by correlated outputs, timing and funding. A facet earns one basalt per attested epoch, a non-transferable unit of judged tenure split evenly among its members, and voting weight is basalt squared. A farm of k clones in one facet gets k(t/k)² = t²/k weight, so adding clones shrinks it, and matching k veterans needs k decorrelated facets each aged t epochs. It breaks if clones decorrelate cheaply or epoch attesters collude.
